violations.text: Soap was not available at the hand-washing sink in the kitchen. Hand-washing sinks must be provided with a supply of hand cleaning liquid, powder, or bar soap. Corrected On-Site. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 06/03/2026
Handwashing sinks in restrooms and bar is lacking signage. A sign or poster musted be posted notifying foo employees of handwashing. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 06/03/2026
Cheese was observed with mold. PIC voluntarily disposed of. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/03/2026

Molluscan Shellfish tags did not have all of the required information.(Last date of use ) were lacking. Molluscan shellfish tags must be maintained for 90 days in chronological order and the date when the last shellfish was used from the bag must be noted on the shellfish tag. New Violation. Correct By: 06/03/2026

Food contact surfaces of equipment/utensils (can opener and ice machine) were observed with an accumulation of food and debris. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. Unit taken out of service to be washed and sanitized. New Violation. Correct By: 06/03/2026

(Pasta and cooked eggplant ), which was prepared in advance, was not cooled to 70 degrees Fahrenheit in 2 hours and then to 41 degrees Fahrenheit within 4 hours.PIC voluntarily disposed of product. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/03/2026

The door to the outside, located in the (near basement area), is not tight-fitting. Outer openings of a food establishment must be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by tight-fitting doors. New Violation. Correct By: 06/10/2026

The cutting boards in the (kitchen ) are very scratched and scored. Cutting blocks and boards that are subject to scratching and scoring shall be resurfaced if they can no longer be effectively cleaned and sanitized, or discarded if they are not capable of being resurfaced. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 06/03/2026
The non-food contact surfaces of the (food storage shelves in basement) have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris. New Violation. Correct By: 06/03/2026

The floors in kitchen basement have an accumulation of soil residue and/or food debris. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. New Violation. Correct By: 06/03/2026

Unnecessary and/or non-functional equipment or items were observed in the (basement) area. Establishments shall be kept free of unnecessary and/or non-functional equipment and litter to prevent harborage conditions. New Violation. Correct By: 07/03/2026
The (walls ) in the (basement ) area is in poor repair. Observed holes The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 06/17/2026

Tongs were observed in the hand-washing sink. A hand-washing sink must not be used for purposes other than hand washing. PIC removed tongs and relocated nearby utensil crock. Corrected On-Site. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 05/06/2025

Working containers of liquid ingredients are not labeled with the common name of the food. Working containers holding food or food ingredients that are removed from their original packages, such as flour, herbs, salt, sugar, and spices must be labeled with the common name of the food. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 05/06/2025

Buckets of olives were observed stored on the floor in the basement storage. Food must be stored at least 6 inches above the floor. PIC and inspector discussed temporary storage options. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 05/20/2025
Cold drawer door gaskets were observed in poor repair. New Violation. Correct By: 06/17/2025

Utensils were observed in the hand-washing sink in the kitchen; a strainer was observed in the hand-washing sink at the bar. A hand-washing sink must not be used for purposes other than hand washing. Items removed. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 05/06/2025
The hand-washing sink in the bar was lacking paper towels. New Violation. Correct By: 05/06/2025

Molluscan shellfish tags must be maintained for 90 days in chronological order and the date when the last shellfish was used from the bag must be noted on the shellfish tag. New Violation. Correct By: 05/06/2025

Molluscan Shellfish (oysters) located in the cold drawer did not have the proper identification tags. Molluscan Shellstock tags must remain attached to the container in which the Molluscan Shellstock are received until the container is empty. Staff retrieved tag and placed in pan. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 05/06/2025

Food contact surfaces of equipment/utensils (can opener, ice machine) were observed with an accumulation of food and debris. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. Items taken out of service to be cleaned and sanitized. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 05/06/2025

Cheese was observed held at 45 degrees Fahrenheit in the prep unit; ambient temperature was 55 degrees. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. All foods requiring refrigeration were moved to other units or placed on ice. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 05/06/2025

Working containers of dry and liquid ingredients are not labeled with the common name of the food. Working containers holding food or food ingredients that are removed from their original packages, such as flour, herbs, salt, sugar, and spices must be labeled with the common name of the food. New Violation. Correct By: 05/06/2025

Cases of produce and chicken were observed stored on the floor in the walk-in; a bucket of olives were observed stored on the floor in the dry storage area. Food must be stored at least 6 inches above the floor. New Violation. Correct By: 05/20/2025

A knife (between wall and prep table) and ice scoop (dirty table) was observed stored on an unclean surface between uses. During pauses in food preparation, utensils must be stored on a clean surface or in a clean, protected location. Items taken to be cleaned and sanitized. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 05/06/2025
The following were observed not in good repair: -prep unit (PIC stated new unit has been ordered) -beverage cooler in basement. New Violation. Correct By: 05/20/2025
The non-food contact surfaces of the cold drawers have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris. New Violation. Correct By: 05/20/2025
The hose connected to the faucet at the mop sink is lacking a backflow prevention device. New Violation. Correct By: 05/20/2025

The following have an accumulation of soil residue and/or food debris: -walls behind prep table -fan guard of the walk-in -shelf over grill top. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. New Violation. Correct By: 05/20/2025
